value: THE REOPEN QUEUE IS NOW EMPTY, AND ITS LAST TWO ENTRIES ARE ARTIFACTS OF THE SECOND, DELIBERATELY-UNFIXED DEFECT THAT claim.RC_stale-reopen-queue-is-a-classifier-artifact.20260901.v1 NAMED IN ITS OWN TEXT. That record fixed the CONVERSION test (43 -> 4 candidates) and explicitly left the FORM test reading the whole record, on the reasoning that law_screen legitimately documents forms tried. The residue of that decision is the entire surviving queue. Both live candidates were verified by reading their record text, and both are false positives - each documents its failing form in unusual detail, but in vocabulary outside the five-word `form_terms` whitelist (offsetof / typed alias / repeated cast / inline cast / declared alias). debug_camera_pos: CAPPED with three distinct measured axes (declaration order, sum-expression shape, product-statement order), a named mechanism (MWCC issues our dy load first and groups the loads, permuting which scratch FPR each squared term lands in), and an explicit do-not-retry that is stronger than a park - it warns that re-splitting the nested-assignment sum LOOKS free on every cheap metric yet costs ~0.09 fuzzy, a trap the queue would have walked the next agent straight into. draw_inventory_panel: CAPPED with probes C1-C5 and D1-D4 including a decisive pair experiment, a full recovered stack map for both streams, three named remaining mechanisms, and it AUTHORED a law (claim.law.opt-lifetimes-off-slots-only-unregisterized-locals.20260831.v1). Neither is a conversion cap; by residual_class they are SCHEDULE and MIXED. NO RE-PROBE WAS WARRANTED OR PERFORMED. GENERALISATION, and the reason this is worth a record rather than a note: the parent record's lesson was 'never match tool names or cited record ids as evidence about a record's subject'. The form test fails for the mirror-image reason - it requires a CLOSED VOCABULARY to describe an OPEN domain. Failing forms in this project are named in the language of whatever mechanism was tried ('the arm-swapped ternary', 'block-scope cursor', 'staging local', 'sum-expression shape', 'base+index rematerialization'), so a fixed whitelist necessarily scores the best-documented parks as undocumented, and the better a record explains itself in domain terms the more likely it is to be flagged. RECOMMENDATION: retire the `failing_form_undocumented` reason rather than extend its whitelist - the extension has no terminating condition. The measured substitute already exists and already works: age-screen parks against the law wave (claim.law.park-law-age-revisit-census.20260831.v1). That method, not the heuristic, is what selected this run's two genuine targets; one of them, StartThrowMagicFX, went EXACT this pass, and the live heuristic had nominated neither.
